question: Write a few sentences of a story about a bird or beast.
answer: A martin built its nest under the eaves of a house. In the spring the male and female martins arrived, and began to think about housekeeping. The straw was first collected, and then the feathers. By and by six white eggs were laid, and the business of hatching succeeded. The young birds were produced, and fed by both parents, until they were able to feed themselves, and the whole family flew away together.

question: Write a few sentences of a story about a bird or beast.
answer: A fox was observed stealing softly towards a poultry-yard. He crept along under the hedges, and came up to the gate unperceived. Here he stopped to listen, and, hearing no noise, ventured to peep in. The coast being clear, he walked boldly forward, and, jumping into the yard, seized a fat hen. But, in jumping back again, over-strained himself, and fell disabled among the poultry. The owner ran out, and caught him by the neck. Thus the thief was punished, for his felony.

question: Write a few sentences of a story about a bird or beast.

question: Write a few sentences of a story about a bird or beast.
answer: A fierce-looking dog was standing guard over a provision shop in a poor part of London. A little bird came and picked up the crumbs that fell from the table. The dog did not molest the bird, but wagged his tail as if pleased to see it fed. At length the bird went too near the mouth of the shop drain, and fell in. question: Write a few sentences of a story about a bird or beast.
answer: A beautiful white heron was seen yesterday morning walking leisureiy along the banks of the river. The summer had come, and the heron was going northward to join its species in the breeding season. In the autumn it will return southwards. In the winter it will be found in Egypt and in India, and in the summer in Europe and in Siberia.

question: Write a few sentences of a story about a bird or beast.
answer: A little bird was seen early in the morning flying southward over a great city. In its beak it bore a single straw. But the straw which it carried in the morning was still grasped firmly in its claws when it sank to rest. question: Write a few sentences of a story about a bird or beast.
answer: A fox was observed stealing softly towards a poultry yard. He entered at a corner, and quickly made choice of a fine fat goose, which he seized by the neck, and ran off with towards the woods. The goose cried out murder! as the fox carried her away; but she cried in vain. Reynard was pursued, and the goose recovered. Moral.-Let thieves and robbers learn from this fable, not to flatter themselves that they shall escape detected and unpunished.

question: Write a few sentences of a story about a bird or beast.
answer: A large eagle was seen flying over the town of Berwick upon Tweed. The inhabitants watched its flight with interest, and long continued to gaze at it, as it sailed slowly onwards to the south. At length it disappeared, and was lost to sight. Thus passed away England’s enemy in the olden time, Scotland’s invader, and the disturber of quiet spirits.

question: Write a few sentences of a story about a bird or beast.

question: Write a few sentences of a story about a bird or beast.
answer: A lark was flying up and singing gaily in the morning sunshine. A sportsman fired at, and missed it. The little minstrel mounted higher still, and continued his song. A second and a third shot were unavailing; and the lark pursued the course of his joyous flight. At last, he sank to the earth, and alighted on a clover field. There he remained quiet for a few minutes, and then rose again, and sang sweetly as before. He soared upwards still further, and yet further, till he became a speck in the blue sky, and finally disappeared from view.

answer: A beautiful stag was seen yesterday morning feeding quietly in a field near the high-road between London and Hounslow. question: Write a few sentences of a story about a bird or beast.
answer: A fox was observed, early in the morning, making his way rapidly across a field. He was pursued by a number of dogs, and hard pressed, turned towards a covert, into which he disappeared. question: Write a few sentences of a story about a bird or beast.
answer: A fox was observed, one morning in spring, making his way rapidly across the fields towards the woods. He was followed by a pack of hounds, and hard pressed, but still he gained upon them. At length he reached the covert in safety, and the sportsmen came up. In the summer the hounds again met in the same place, and reynard was not to be found. In the autumn the chase was renewed, and again the fox escaped. In the winter the hunters gave him over, and he was seen no more.

question: Write a few sentences of a story about a bird or beast.
answer: A bird was observed flying about in an agitated manner over a particular spot in St. James’s Park. The cause of its alarm was soon discovered; a snake was making towards it from below. The bird mounted higher and higher in the air, and at last disappeared. The snake continued to ascend, until it reached the top of the area-railings, where it remained quiet. The spectators had now leisure to remark it. It was of a brown colour, and about a foot long. After a pause, it dropped gently down, and fell dead upon the walk. The bird returned not.

answer: A squirrel was observed running along a fence. Presently it stopped, and sat erect to listen. It repeated this movement several times, and then went leaping and bounding away over the fields. question: Write a few sentences of a story about a bird or beast.
answer: Abeard was observed early in the morning flying eastward. During the day it continued its course, and in the evening was lost sight of. In the morning it was again seen proceeding westward, and in the evening it disappeared. This was repeated for several days, until at length the bird vanished, and was no more noticed.

question: Write a few sentences of a story about a bird or beast.
answer: A hare was seen early in the morning running across a field. It was pursued by a greyhound, and soon overtaken and killed. The animal was then despatched, and carried to the town, where it was hung up in a poulterer's shop. In the course of the day, it was purchased by a customer, and conveyed to his house, where it was cooked for dinner. The hare was eaten, and pronounced to be excellent food. In the evening, the bones were thrown into the dog-kennel.

question: Write a few sentences of a story about a bird or beast.
answer: A bird was observed flying eastward in the morning, and in the evening westward, in the spring of the year. In the summer, it was again seen in the morning going eastward, and in the autumn, flying westward. In the following spring, it was not noticed. In the succeeding summer, it appeared, for the last time, and then shaped its course to the south. From these observations, it was concluded, that the bird passed the summer in the northern parts of Europe, and the winter in Africa.

question: Write a few sentences of a story about a bird or beast.
answer: A fox was observed yesterday morning, stealing quietly along the side of a hill. He seemed to be bent on mischief, and appeared to make himself acquainted with the lay of the land. In the evening he returned, and passed over the same ground, at a quicker pace. Early this morning he was again afoot, and, running straight forward, disappeared in a valley. _Probably he was going to break fast in a hen-roost.

question: Write a few sentences of a story about a bird or beast.
answer: A sparrow was observed yesterday morning hopping about in the snow. It seemed almost benumbed with cold, but after a time it recovered, and flew away. A hare was started from a field of wheat early in the morning of the same day. The poor thing had fed hardly at all during the winter, and was become so weak that it could hardly run. It crept slowly up the side of a hill, and fell dead at the top.

question: Write a few sentences of a story about a bird or beast.
answer: A bird was observed flying southwards in the middle of winter. The weather was cold and gloomy, and the traveller seemed to be seeking a warmer climate. In the spring the same bird returned, flying northwards. In the summer it was again seen in the same latitude, and in the autumn it disappeared. Thus the year was marked out to the observer.

question: Write a few sentences of a story about a bird or beast.
answer: Al was observed early in the spring flying northwards. It was followed by some boys, and at last was shot. In its crop was found a piece of paper, on which was written, “Follow me no further; I am going to Sweden.” The bird was Swedish, and had been taught to bear this message to its fellows remaining in the south.

After some time, spent in this manner, the squirrel went into a hole in the trunk, and the boy departed. In the evening he returned, and stopped at the foot of the tree again. question: Write a few sentences of a story about a bird or beast.
answer: Abird was observed flying towards the south early in the spring. It was followed by a sportsman, who fired at and wounded it. The poor creature fell; and, fluttering along the ground, was pursued by the relentless enemy. At length it took refuge in a barn, where it was caught. The disabled wing was bound up, and the bird cared for and restored to liberty. In the autumn, the same individual passed back again towards the north, and the winged fugitive was seen following at its heels.

question: Write a few sentences of a story about a bird or beast.
answer: A bird was observed flying southwards in the autumn. In the spring it returned, flying northwards. In the summer it built a nest in a tree, and hatched and reared young ones. In the winter it disappeared, and was not seen again until the following spring.

question: Write a few sentences of a story about a bird or beast.
answer: A fierce-looking eagle was observed flying overhead in a lonely part of the country. The bird appeared to be beating against the wind, and was making in the direction of the sea-shore. It was subsequently ascertained to have been bound for the coast of France. An hour or two afterwards, the eagle was seen again, winging its way back towards England. It had failed in its first attempt, but in a second it was more successful.

question: Write a few sentences of a story about a bird or beast.
answer: A large eagle was observed flying over a remote part of the Scottish Highlands. It was speedily lost to sight, but in a short time re-appeared, bearing in its talons a lamb, which it bore to a neighbouring mountain crag, and there devoured. The shepherds immediately assembled, and shot the royal bird. They skinned the prey, and made waistcoats of the spoil; which are at this day worn by some of the hardy highland sports.

question: Write a few sentences of a story about a bird or beast.
answer: A bird was observed flying solitary over the fields in the eastern part of Yorkshire. No one knew whither it was going, but in a short time it returned, accompanied by a second, and soon after a third made its appearance. The three birds continued together, until they arrived on the coast, where they all alighted on the water. A little while they remained, and then departed for foreign regions. question: Write a few sentences of a story about a bird or beast.
answer: A fine blackbird was observed yesterday morning early, feeding in a quiet field. He had lately bathed himself in the clear stream, and shook the drops from his wings in the sunshine. Then he shook his light plumes into order, and mounted upward, in easy slopes, till he had reached a good height. After this, he flew forward, in a straight course, but not rapidly, clearing the air with a pleasant whistling sound. His business was evidently abroad, for pleasure, and he continued on, till a turning in the stream brought him out of sight.

question: Write a few sentences of a story about a bird or beast.
answer: A was observed early in the morning, flying eastward, above a great city. In the evening, the same bird was seen returning, to roost in the west. Next morning, it had disappeared. During the brief space of twelve hours, it had transacted business in two hemispheres, and vanished. So passes the life of man.

question: Write a few sentences of a story about a bird or beast.
answer: A fox was observed, early in the morning, creeping softly towards a henroost. He seemed to examine the coast carefully before he ventured to enter; and, having satisfied himself that the coast was clear, he stole into the yard, and selected a fine fat pullet, which he carried off in triumph. Let us hope that he had a good dinner.

question: Write a few sentences of a story about a bird or beast.
answer: A little brown bird was seen early in the spring hopping about in a garden. It was busily employed in picking up insects, and seemed very happy. In the summer it built a nest, and reared up its young; and in the autumn departed with them to a warmer climate. In the following spring it came back again. Year after year it returned, at the same season, and lived contentedly among us, till at last it grew old, and died. Thus lived and passed away poor little Dicky.

question: Write a few sentences of a story about a bird or beast.
answer: A fine specimen of the peregrine falcon was killed last week in the north of Scotland. The bird measured fifteen inches from beak to tail, and had claws an inch and a half long. It was of a dark blue colour on the back, and white underneath. The falcon was formerly used in sporting, and was employed to catch other birds; but the practice has been long discontinued in Britain.

question: Write a few sentences of a story about a bird or beast.
answer: A stag was observed passing along the banks of a Highland lake at early dawn. He was evidently making for the bills, and had come down to the margin of the water to slake his thirst. He drank long and deeply, and then shook the drops from his horns, and went on his way rejoicing. In a little time he stopped again, and again quenched his thirst; and a third time he did the same thing. After which he was lost sight of among the mountains.

question: Write a few sentences of a story about a bird or beast.
answer: A fine eagle was observed sailing up the valley of the Tweed. It appeared to be beating against the breeze, and moved rapidly along. The spectator, following it with his eye, saw it sweep round the base of a cliff, and disappear in the air above. A minute or two afterwards it was visible again, gliding seward, and, continuing still to beat upward, soon became a speck, and vanished in the sky. In less than a quarter of an hour it was far out of sight. The bird was bound for the coast of France.

question: Write a few sentences of a story about a bird or beast.
answer: Ahawk flew up from a field yesterday morning, and, after soaring for a short time at a great height in the air, directed his course toward the north-east. He was followed by a companion, of the same species, for a few miles, and then lost sight of. The two birds were probably bound on a migration to a summer residence. In the autumn they will return again to the same part of the country.

question: Write a few sentences of a story about a bird or beast.
answer: A fox was observed, one morning, stealing softly along a hen-roost. He stopped at each little aperture, where a chicken might possibly peep out, and listened. All was quiet; so Reynard ventured a little further, and a little further still, until, at length, he reached the middle of the range. Here he made a full pause. Then, turning his head slowly round, he surveyed the whole line of buildings, with a keen and steady gaze. Satisfied that all was safe, he shot himself into the first hole, and, in an instant, disappeared.

question: Write a few sentences of a story about a bird or beast.
answer: AA sparrow was observed yesterday morning hopping about in the streets. It appeared to be very tame, and fed quietly from some scattered grains. In the evening it went to roost in a hole of a wall. This morning it was not to be seen.

question: Write a few sentences of a story about a bird or beast.
answer: Abird was observed flying southward in the autumn. It was solitary, and had probably come from a northern climate, where the winter was approaching. In the spring the same bird returned, accompanying a flight of swallows, and repairing to a summer residence. A hare, in the winter season, forsook the fields, and took shelter in a barnyard; but, in the summer, returned to its former haunts.

question: Write a few sentences of a story about a bird or beast.
answer: A squirrel was observed early in the morning running along a fence. It seemed to be in great haste, and to have some place in view, which it was anxious to reach. In the course of a few minutes it arrived at its destination--a hole in the tree, which it immediately entered, and thus concluded its journey. The speedy accomplishment of a purpose appeared to be the object of its exertions.

question: Write a few sentences of a story about a bird or beast.
answer: A rabbit was observed yesterday afternoon sitting quietly in the fields. A little boy threw a stone at it, and it ran into a hole. In the evening it came out again, and fed in the same place. It returned to its burrow for the night, and appeared in the morning. This it did for several days successively, and at last disappeared. The animal was probably disturbed by some enemy, and so left the neighbourhood.

question: Write a few sentences of a story about a bird or beast.
answer: A little bird flew into an open window of a house. The inmates fed it, and it remained. In the spring the bird departed, but returned in the following autumn. In the succeeding year it again went away, and again came back; and thus, for several summers and winters, the little visitor appeared and disappeared. At length it came no more. The bird was dead.
